## Episode Thesis

This Friday panel is mostly about politics and the economy, not stocks. The Riksbank signalled rate hikes as inflation and electricity prices rise, and the panel added concerns about the Strait of Hormuz and extra spending from an expected new government. Johanna Jansson did not think the outlook is as dark as 2022. The panel also covered the Left Party's election-fraud scandal, government formation, the Xi–Trump meeting that disappointed markets, and Håkan Samuelsson stepping down as CEO of Volvo Cars. No company received a buy or sell view.
